import builtins
import os
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` followed by a newline to standard output.

    Console output only: this function must not open, create, or write
    any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] started\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_returns_none(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fn: Callable[[str, str], object] = log_line
    result = fn("warn", "disk low")
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert result is None


def test_log_line_preserves_case_and_spacing(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("Debug", "  padded   message ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[Debug]   padded   message \n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("error", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[error] \n"


def test_log_line_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_log_line_multiple_calls_in_order(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("info", "one")
    log_line("error", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[info] one\n[error] two\n"


def test_log_line_message_with_brackets_and_newline(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("info", "[x] a\nb")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[info] [x] a\nb\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_file_system(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise AssertionError("file system access is not allowed")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "mkdir", forbidden)

    log_line("info", "no files please")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[info] no files please\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
